answer: Propose escrow-weighted plume simulation access. Each key locks at least 10 credits for an hour; each scheduling pulse divides fixed compute proportionally to stake, not key count. Validators check key/hour locks and deny access on failure; no credit can back two keys. Stake returns afterward; hardware is reusable capital, electricity a recurring expense. Wealth can dominate; simulation quality is unchecked. Shared hosts cannot create a quota spiral: ten parallel keys locking 10 each tie up 100 credits and get the same total share as one locking 100.
